site_number: LAND FORMING PART OF FORMER WESTERN INTERNATIONAL MARKET
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description:
Erection of construction and demolition waste recycling facility, concrete batching plant and associated weighbridge, weighbridge office, site office and welfare facilities, storage bays, substation, car and HGV parking and other ancillary structures, and use of land for fleet parking (works applied for retrospectively).  Consent sought for temporary period ending 21 December 2027.

[14 DAY RECONSULTATION - additional revised information received]
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The buildings and plant equipment and use of the land hereby approved shall
cease use and be removed on or before 21 December 2027 and the land
restored to an undeveloped form or in accordance with another scheme of work
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 2 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in all respects in full
accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans
submitted (see list of drawing numbers above) therewith and approved by the Local Planning
Authority

Condition : 3 - The boundary treatment as shown on the drawing numbered H111930-PC1
Rev: D and received on 01/02/2021, shall be implemented and maintained in
accordance with the approved drawing for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in full accordance with
the Operational Statement dated August 2020 and received on 18/08/2020.

Condition : 5 - No later than 3 months after the date of this decision the development hereby
approved shall operate in full accordance with the Dust Management and Monitoring
Plan ? Dated July 2020; Air Quality Assessment ? Dated June 2020; Acoustic
Technical Report ? Dated June 2020 ? all received on 18/08/2020, and Noise
Technical Note ? Dated 14/01/2021; Air Quality Consultation Response ? Dated
19/01/2021 ? both received: 01/02/2021 and Air Quality Statement (13 July 2021)
and Noise Assessment (14 July 2021) both received on 15 July 2021.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the submitted and approved plans, within six months of the date
of this permission, details of the pedestrian crossing over the access road from
Southall Lane shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority.
The submitted details shall show the crossing width of 2.4m and the tactile
paving aligned correctly. The development shall thereafter be carried out in
accordance with the approved details and no later than three months after the
date of the approval, and maintained in accordance with the approved details for
the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 7 - The pedestrian and cycle access paths and gates (either independent on
shared) shall be no less than 1.2m wide.

Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in full accordance with
the Car Park Management Plan ? Dated June 2020 and the Servicing
Management and Vehicle Routing Plan ? Dated 04 June 2020, both
received on: 18/08/2020

Condition : 9 - a) Within three months of the date of this permission, full details of the Electrical
Vehicle Charging Points (EVCPs) - including manufacturers? specification
and drawing showing plan and elevational form, shall be submitted to and
approved in writing. The development shall thereafter be carried out in
accordance with the approved details and no later than three months after
the date of the approval, and maintained in accordance with the approved
details for the lifetime of the development.
b) No later than three years from the date of this permission, details outlining
the usage of the EVCPs shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. If
the survey indicates that the usage of the EVCPs is exceeding 80% of
capacity or capacity is exceeded, details showing the location of additional
EVCPs and if different to those approved under Part A of this condition - the
specification of the proposed EVCPs, shall also be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall
thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details and no
later than three months after the date of the approval, and maintained in
accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 10 - The landscaping as shown on the drawing numbered H11930-PC7G and
received on 01/02/2021, shall be implemented and maintained in accordance
with the approved drawing for the lifetime of the development.
